about: A2 port/manifold geometry; loss figures are PRELIMINARY and are NOT part of calibrate.tree_dp_pa

assumptions.ring_cross_section: rectangle 6 mm wide x 2 mm deep (matches rect_dp)

geometry.merged_note: merged grooves share a manifold; the per-leaf model charges each leaf a full-length duct and ignores the larger shared cross-section, so the groove term is expected to over-estimate, not to be exact
geometry.mesh_note: union of closed primitives: end caps at multi-way nodes and groove tips inside the ring are interior faces; watertight per primitive, not one boolean-unioned solid. Measured decomposition of the 236 directed edges with multiplicity >= 3: 228 vertical spokes + 8 horizontal spokes. Mechanism: for a horizontal cylinder (axis in the xy plane) u = axis x zhat is horizontal and v = -zhat, so the rim points at t = 90 and 270 deg are always center -/+ r*zhat; at a node with k outgoing channels the k child end caps and the parent end cap (k caps at the root) are coincident 12-gons of the same radius, so those two rim points are shared by k+1 (k) caps and yield 2 spokes x 2 directions = 4 edges per node. 57 nodes have out-degree >= 2, giving 57 x 2 x 2 = 228 vertical spokes; the remaining 8 are the root's 4 collinear radial spokes x 2 directions. Multiplicity distribution: mult=3 for 220 vertical + 8 horizontal, mult=4 for the 4 spokes at the root (k=4) and at the single k=3 node. All 236 reverse counts match and boundary_edges = 0, so closure holds. 2 vertex-connected components = main assembly + the 16-vertex collector frame, which shares no vertices.

stl_closure.note: closed <=> every directed edge occurs as often as its reverse; each primitive is generated closed, so this proves no missing facet, NOT that the overlapping union is one valid solid
